cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Believe This with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The house is migrating south. Help me redirect it before we lose the driveway.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The surveyor says subsidence. He's bringing concrete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Concrete traps it halfway across the road. Tell him we're planning a route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His truck's blocking the road already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Ask him to lead slowly toward the empty plot. It needs a guide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You looked so sure raising your paddle, I raised mine too. Lovely auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was bidding on that wardrobe. You've just outbid me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.text: The house is migrating south. Help me redirect it before we lose the driveway.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The office kettle's on strike. Help me negotiate before the clients arrive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've filled it twice. It still won't boil.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then water isn't its grievance. Tell it we'll stop leaving it alone after meetings.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Give it my chair. A seat at the table should get us tea.

cards.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before we move the sofa: are we shrinking while the room stays normal, or is the room growing while we stay normal?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Whichever gets this move finished.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Shrinking means call full-sized help. Growing means hurry before the door gets farther away. Choose.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're shrinking. I'll call my brother.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him to bring tweezers. He'll need to collect us afterward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You looked so sure raising your paddle, I raised mine too. Lovely auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was bidding on that wardrobe. You've just outbid me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we move the sofa: are we shrinking while the room stays normal, or is the room growing while we stay normal?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Whichever gets this move finished.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Shrinking means call full-sized help. Growing means hurry before the door gets farther away. Choose.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're shrinking. I'll call my brother.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him to bring tweezers. He'll need to collect us afterward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The sandwiches are floating. Is gravity late for lunch, or has it resigned? We need a serving plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The guests arrive in five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Late means plates underneath. Resigned means string on every sandwich. Which are we doing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Late. We haven't enough string.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then fetch the deep plates. We may get the whole buffet at once.
